source.member: ACE.Server.Entity.Chess.ChessLogic (DoMove, GenerateMoves, InCheck, InCheckmate, EvaluateBoard, UndoMove, AsyncCalculateAiSimpleMove)
source.notes: Per ply: moves = GenerateMoves(Turn) (flags|color|type|from|to|promotion|captured|move|halfMove|enPassant|guid|capturedGuid); tries = DoMove(color, from, to) calls [color, fx, fy, tx, ty, result] (the last OK one is the move played; a call that threw has no result); ai = AsyncCalculateAiSimpleMove [result, from, to]; undo = UndoMove(n); then check [White, Black], mate = InCheckmate(Turn, false), eval = EvaluateBoard, state [turn, move, halfMove, castling0, castling1, enPassant, history], board; on the game's last ply full = InCheckmate(Turn, true) and the state and board after it (it moves and undoes on the live board and leaves the wrong side to move, so the game ends there). A throw ends the game with {"throws": type}. The move played is chosen by a policy that prefers promotions, en passant, castling and pawn advances; a quiet promotion is undone on the next ply (UndoMove(1)).
